synth.notes:
Ring+beam move y-+6 carrying on-beam blocks and pushing hit blocks (chain); a block leaving the colour-4 field cancels the move.
Beam w +-6 in [1,43]; a hooked next/collected block at tip-5 drags the on-beam blocks, an unhooked extend pushes swept next/collected blocks; if the group is blocked the beam changes alone.
Tags: collect = hooked next with every other on-beam block collected (new next = first todo by legend x); revert = unhooked collected block off the beam.
Background: field 4, rail period-6 2/3 in non-field columns with 2/3, rows top+2..bot-2, else 5. HUD bar = (n-1)//3 threes from the right, n = non-click actions; clicks are no-ops.
Open: the bar phase is hidden (stateless 32/45; fallback n=3z+1). Ring y bounds and multi-level resets were not observed.
